build_bailing_moe_model: build a BailingMoEForCausalLM model with config and quant_config for causal language modeling
run_bailing_moe_forward: run the BailingMoEForCausalLM forward pass with input_ids, positions, and forward_batch
load_bailing_moe_weights: load model weights into BailingMoEForCausalLM using load_weights with stacked and expert param mappings
get_bailing_moe_expert_location: get the model config for expert location using get_model_config_for_expert_location from BailingMoEForCausalLM
capture_eagle3_aux_layers: capture auxiliary hidden states at specified layers via set_eagle3_layers_to_capture on BailingMoEForCausalLM
